resale_co.name: Certificate of Inspection (resales or rentals)
resale_co.issued_by: Chesterfield Township Construction Office (Code Enforcement Officer)
resale_co.lead_time: No set lead time; the certificate takes 3 business days to generate after all repairs and certifications are in, so allow time before closing.
requirements: Smoke detectors on each floor, working; tested by the township inspector (or certification from the monitoring company if monitored)
Carbon monoxide detectors near the bedrooms
Visible 2.5 to 10 lb ABC fire extinguisher hung no higher than 60 inches and within 10 feet of the kitchen (April 2024 form)
Original certifications for the heater, heater chimney, wood fireplaces or woodstoves, and their chimneys
Well water test by a certified lab if on well water; buyer signs that they were told the results
GFI outlets outside, within 6 feet of the kitchen sink and in every bathroom; three-prong outlet for the washer; no open spaces in the panel; no multi-gang outlets or extension cords
Guardrails and handrails on all stairways; halls and stairways lighted
Heater and water heater relief valve pipe within 6 to 8 inches of the floor
Gutters, downspouts, screens, windows, siding, paint, decks, porches and accessory buildings in repair
Interior wall holes, tub and shower tile and leaking faucets repaired
No trash or rubbish on the property
House number visible on the front of the house or the mailbox

fees.label: Resale certificate of inspection (includes one re-inspection)
Each additional inspection after the included re-inspection
fees.quote: If additional inspections are required, there is a $25.00 fee per inspection.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Inspection, mark Resale, and pay by check or cash at the Township of Chesterfield, 295 Bordentown-Chesterfield Road. Call 609-298-2311 ext. 140 to schedule the inspection (voice mail requests are accepted). Turn in original certifications and the well water form if needed.

evidence.quote: REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTIFICATE OF INSPECTION RESALES OR RENTALS

All violations must be corrected and re-inspected and all certifications must be received in order to process the Certificate of Inspection. When all requirements have been met, three (3) business days are needed to generate the Certificate.
Glenn McMahon Code Enforcement Officer (609) 298-2311 ext. 140

resale_co.notes: The live township site (chesterfieldtwpnj.gov) is behind a Cloudflare check, so Internet Archive copies were used: the application https://chesterfieldtwpnj.gov/images/construction/certificate_of_inspection_app41824.pdf (captured 2024-05-20) and the Construction page https://www.chesterfieldtwpnj.gov/construction (captured 2024-12-28), which links a 'Certificate Of Inspection' page that was not archived. The township ordinance on ecode360 (CH1100) could not be opened, so the requirement comes from the township's own resale/rental certificate form rather than the ordinance text. The email is shown on the page as 'glenn [at] chesterfieldtwp.com'. Fees and contacts may have changed since late 2024.

requirements: Smoke detectors on each floor and carbon monoxide detectors near the bedrooms, tested by the township inspector during the Certificate of Inspection
2.5 to 10 lb ABC fire extinguisher, visible, no higher than 60 inches, within 10 feet of the kitchen (April 2024 form still lists it)

authorities.name: Chesterfield Township Construction Office (smoke and CO checked in the township Certificate of Inspection)

fees.label: Combined resale Certificate of Inspection including smoke/CO check (paid once)

authorities.how_to_apply: Part of the township Certificate of Inspection application; no separate smoke certificate application was found.

evidence.quote: Smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors will be tested by the Township Inspector during the physical inspection of your property, unless you have a monitored system.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Chesterfield (LEA registry code S; Fire Official Louis Kilmer, (609)633-6132), but the DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) does not mark Chesterfield with 'SC' (state issues smoke certs), and the DCA directory lists 'Chesterfield Twp Constr Office' (300 Bordentown Chesterfield Rd, (609) 298-0426) for smoke detector compliance. The township's own form says its inspector tests smoke and CO detectors during the Certificate of Inspection, which under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3(a)1 stands in for a separate state certificate. The directory's address and phone differ from the township form (295 Bordentown-Chesterfield Road, 609-298-2311). The form (April 2024) still lists an extinguisher; P.L.2025, c.19 (February 3, 2025) removed it from the state rule.

other_items.label: Well water test
other_items.detail: If on well water, have it tested by a certified lab; the buyer signs the township water test certification.

other_items.label: Heater and chimney certifications
other_items.detail: Original certifications for the heater, heater chimney, fireplaces or woodstoves and their chimneys are required before the certificate is issued.
